name: outlook-mcp-rs
description: Drive classic Outlook on Windows from Claude Code: the outlook-mcp-rs MCP server, skills for using it safely, and an optional calendar-autopilot approval hook.

server_path.title: outlook-mcp-rs.exe
server_path.description: Full path to outlook-mcp-rs.exe (from the GitHub release or cargo build --release). Classic Outlook must be running on this machine.

calendar_autopilot.title: Calendar autopilot
calendar_autopilot.description: Run reads, silent meeting responses (notify: false) and changes to personal appointments (require_no_attendees: true) without asking. Anything that can reach other people still asks.
